answer: Signal-based Sybil resistance mechanisms, such as stake-slashing matrices and verifiable delay functions, impose substantial economic costs on attackers, locking up substantial capital. These mechanisms ensure that engaging in Sybil attacks results in negative expected utility. The cryptographic proof-of-stake systems like prism and lotus inherently promote Byzantine Fault Tolerance by disincentivizing false signal proliferation and ensuring that truthful signals prevail, sustaining integrity and security across autonomous agents.
